posts.title: 📷 Some macro photos of my grandfather’s camera
posts.description: A few months ago I wrote about my grandfather’s TLR camera , which I had then-recently inherited. I’m embarrassed to admit that since posting the article I’ve yet to go out taking photos with it again, but it’s such a gorgeous piece of engineering that I can’t help but take photos of it. 📷 Olympus OM-20, Zuiko 50mm f /1.8 + 46mm extension tubes 🎞️ Ilford HP5+ pushed to 800
